access_contract: Only explicit configuration metadata; no model, tokenizer, source labels or response files opened.
boundary_contract: Tokenize unchanged prompt plus canonical candidate; reject any saved-prefix mismatch or merging.
eos_union: distinct disjoint variants, summed for each candidate
event_definition: canonical integer continuation tokens followed by one declared EOS ID
limitation: Absolute masses cover only the declared finite integer-plus-EOS events. Support-conditional entropy and margin describe that restricted set; they are not overall full-answer confidence.
preparation_stage: declaration only; actual prompt/event token preparation remains pending
